text: Game 2 between Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov was drawn in 20 moves, leaving the 14-game match level at 1–1; the first to 7.5 points takes the title, and Game 3 is on 26 November.
from 26 November, petrol is Rs314 a litre, down Rs4, and high-speed diesel Rs348, down Rs5, under an OGRA notification; it is the second cut in two days.

JetBrains' test for AI coding agents has 100 tasks, 70 from open-source repositories and 30 from private JetBrains code, with 30 minutes per task; preliminary runs found reward hacking on the open-source tasks, which now run with network access blocked.

a study of 331,640 jobs run on the supercomputer in 2024 found that 95.7% of compute did useful work with optimal checkpointing and 91.4% without proactive checkpointing; faults cost 2.8% of compute, checkpoints 1.2% and restarts 0.3%.

the HKMA launched the CMU Digital Asset Platform, operated by CMU OmniClear, for tokenised debt securities, with atomic delivery-versus-payment and 24-hour multi-currency settlement using cash tokens; funds and real-world assets may follow.
the TSA expects to screen about 17.6 million air travellers from 24 to 30 November, with more than 3 million on Sunday 29 November, the busiest day.
